final: WITH counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_entries FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_entries) AS entries_per_driver FROM counts) SELECT driverId, qualifying_entries, qualifying_entries * 1.0 / entries_per_driver AS ratio_to_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, driverId LIMIT 10
